headline: Jalisco's electronics leadership contrasts with low local supply: IP
summary: Jalisco leads Mexico's semiconductor sector and is its second-largest exporter, yet local suppliers account for only 8 to 10%, prompting calls for policies and financing for SMEs.
why: Semiconductor assembly and export strength in Mexico depends on how deeply local suppliers integrate into global electronics value chains.
original_headline: Liderazgo electrónico de Jalisco contrasta con baja proveeduría local: IP
